description: Use workbook-relative hyperlinks so Budget links in future plan copies stay within their own workbook.
before:
=IF(
  month_count = 0,
  0,
  LET(
    keys, COL_VALUES(source_table, lookup_col),
    first_row, ROW(INDEX(source_table, 1, 1)) + MATCH(lookup_value, keys, 0),
    last_row, ROW(INDEX(source_table, 1, 1)) + LOOKUP(2, ARRAYFORMULA(1 / (keys = lookup_value)), SEQUENCE(ROWS(keys))),
    first_col, COLUMN(INDEX(source_table, 1, 1)) - 1 + MATCH(start_month, INDEX(source_table, 1, 0), 0),
    HYPERLINK(
      "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1mxvjXTedpabDNPl-WOEie4vdpeIwCnXDlzvihZvUML4/edit#gid=" & sheet_id & "&range=" & ADDRESS(first_row, first_col, 4) & ":" & ADDRESS(last_row, first_col + month_count - 1, 4),
      amount
    )
  )
)
after:
=IF(
  month_count = 0,
  0,
  LET(
    keys, COL_VALUES(source_table, lookup_col),
    first_row, ROW(INDEX(source_table, 1, 1)) + MATCH(lookup_value, keys, 0),
    last_row, ROW(INDEX(source_table, 1, 1)) + LOOKUP(2, ARRAYFORMULA(1 / (keys = lookup_value)), SEQUENCE(ROWS(keys))),
    first_col, COLUMN(INDEX(source_table, 1, 1)) - 1 + MATCH(start_month, INDEX(source_table, 1, 0), 0),
    HYPERLINK(
      "#gid=" & sheet_id & "&range=" & ADDRESS(first_row, first_col, 4) & ":" & ADDRESS(last_row, first_col + month_count - 1, 4),
      amount
    )
  )
)
rollback: Restore before as the BUDGET_TIMELINE_LINK named-function definition.
repositoryScope: Only this migration record belongs to the change. No Apps Script source changed; clasp push is not required.
